title: Global Illumination in C++
description: Crafted a Monte Carlo ray tracer in C++ that simulates realistic global illumination featuring transparent, reflective, and Lambertian surfaces.

title: Procedural Planet in THREE.js
description: Created a procedurally generated planet using noise to generate terrain, clouds, and stars in THREE.js.

title: Web App for Selecting Courses
description: Developed a web app for selecting master's courses as a Bachelor's thesis. Built with React and Google Firebase for user management and database.

title: Animated Short in Blender
description: Produced an animated short film from scratch in Blender, where responsibilities included animation, lighting, and props.

title: Singing Web Game in P5.js
description: Developed a singing game using p5.js, where you collect candies using your voice. Primarily managed user inputs and audio analysis.

title: Chatbot using ML
description: Implemented a Python chatbot using TF-IDF and cosine similarity. Processes conversational datasets, extracts features, and engages in text-based conversations.

title: Curling Simulation in UE5
description: Investigated the movement of curling stones, employing Euler Approximation to simulate friction and curling effect. Developed in Unreal Engine 5.

title: The Blender Guru Donut
description: Followed The Blender Guru Donut tutorial covering modeling, texturing, and rendering in Blender. Learned how to create a detailed donut scene.

title: Online Multiplayer Mini Golf
description: Created a web-based multiplayer golf game where players compete in real-time. Built with React and Google Firebase; the golf game itself uses Three.js.

title: Cheddar Chase: A Godot Game
description: A 2D top-down pixel-art platformer built in Godot where you play as a mouse collecting cheese while dodging enemies. Custom Aseprite art, AI behavior, and original music. Honored as a LIU Game Award finalist.

title: React Native Password Validator
description: A customizable React Native component for evaluating and displaying password strength. Provides password recommendations, dynamic status indicators, and confirmation support with visual feedback.

title: React Native Bank Card Form
description: A React Native UI component designed to handle bank card input values. Includes multiple callback functions to manage changes within the component.

title: Lightfall - Bigmode Game Jam
description: A 2D platformer where you play as a light source and must collect batteries to stay alive. Created for Bigmode Game Jam 2025.

title: Particle System in C++
description: Created a minimal particle system with a small graphical interface that allows for visual editing of parameters.

title: Simple Pong in Unity
description: A minimal Pong game in Unity featuring smooth paddle controls, basic AI, and score tracking.

title: Simple Snake in Unity
description: A minimal retro snake game in Unity.

title: Travel Cost Estimator
description: A travel cost estimator using Mapbox and a gas price API.
